drills.label: Cold open
drills.question_line: SAM: Here is your opening scenario. A retailer with eight thousand staff runs on Google Workspace
drills.answer_line: SAM: That's the constraint. The answer is B.
drills.stem: 8,000 staff on Google Workspace with a Google Cloud commitment. IT wants one assistant across Gmail, Drive and Calendar, run from consoles they already manage, data in the EU. Legal insists on Claude for contract review. What do you recommend?

options.B: Gemini Enterprise for all staff, with Claude Opus 5.5 switched on for legal, billed pay as you go
options.C: A custom assistant on the Gemini API with API keys
options.D: Gemini Enterprise for everyone; tell legal Gemini tops the leaderboards

drills.why: Fit the platform the customer named, and bring Claude in where the team asks. A adds a second console and contract, C is a build on the key-based door, D overrules legal with a text preference board. Confirm where Claude's processing runs for legal, since the EU rule covers it too.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. A telecom on Google Cloud wants a contact-centre agent
drills.answer_line: SAM: B. The constraint is real-time speech
drills.stem: A telecom on Google Cloud wants a contact-centre agent that holds spoken conversations with callers in real time. Its architect wants one managed service to handle the audio end to end, with no separate speech services chained in. Which model does it build on?

options.A: Claude Sonnet 5.5 through Model Garden, prompts tuned for short replies
options.B: The Gemini Live API for the spoken conversation
options.C: Claude behind a third-party speech-to-text and text-to-speech chain
options.D: Gemma 4 on servers in each call centre

drills.why: Real-time speech in one managed service is what the Live API is built for; A has no speech path. C chains in the separate speech services the architect ruled out, and agent boards don't measure speech. D adds hardware nobody asked for.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. For each statement, say true or false.
drills.answer_line: SAM: All four right. Gemini four is implicit caching only.
drills.prompt: True or false? 1) Gemini 4 lets you create and manage explicit cache objects. 2) Model Garden on Agent Platform offers Claude alongside Gemini. 3) New paid-tier Gemini API projects store generated content by default. 4) Batch on the main Gemini text models costs half the standard rate.
drills.answer: 1) False: implicit caching only. 2) True. 3) True, since late October 2026. 4) True.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. Choose two. An insurer's platform team on Google Cloud writes Java.
drills.answer_line: SAM: C is right. B is a loyal answer
drills.scenario: Java agent platform calling a partner
drills.stem: Choose two. A Java platform team on Google Cloud wants an agent framework on GKE with Claude for the hardest reasoning step, and its agents must call a partner's claims agent on a different stack. Which two fit?

options.A: The ADK in Java, using its Claude adapter
options.B: The Claude Agent SDK in Java
options.C: A2A for the call to the partner's agent
options.D: Ask the partner to rebuild its agent as an MCP tool inside the insurer's process
options.E: Gemini Enterprise seats for the platform team

drills.why: The ADK is model-agnostic and has Java; the Agent SDK is Python and TypeScript only. A2A connects agents across owners. D takes control from the partner; E is the wrong layer.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. A fintech's forty engineers use Jules
drills.answer_line: SAM: C. Jules is read-only and switches off at the end of December
drills.scenario: Jules and Gemini CLI users before year end
drills.stem: Forty engineers use Jules for background pull requests and Gemini CLI on personal AI Pro accounts. What should they do before year end?

options.B: Move to the Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions on personal AI Pro plans
options.C: Export Jules work, trial Antigravity and Claude Code on their own repos and tickets, choose on results
options.D: Fork the Gemini CLI repository and keep running it on personal accounts

drills.why: Jules shuts down 31 December; personal AI Pro lost Gemini CLI and the Code Assist extensions in June. A fork keeps the code, not the service. Their own code beats any public board.

drills.question_line: SAM: Recall first. Pause and name the five segments we walked through for Google
drills.answer_line: ALEX: Models: does the job need voice or video?
drills.prompt: Name the five segments covered for Google, and one question to ask a customer at each.
drills.answer: Models: voice or video? Platform: API key or Agent Platform? Agents: which language, whose agent are we calling? Coding: still on Gemini CLI or Jules? Enterprise: do they live in Workspace?
